Isaiah 1.summary: Judah is portrayed as a rebellious child and a diseased body, while Jerusalem has become unjust. The chapter contrasts a corrupt city with a future faithful city (Isaiah 1:1–31).

The chapter addresses rebellion and grief within the prophetic material: Judah is portrayed as a rebellious child and a diseased body, while Jerusalem has become unjust.
